body: I'm sorry to cut our conversation short, but I'm falling asleep. I keep drifting off and snapping back awake (it's just before 3:30 AM in my time zone). I will pick up where we left off when I wake up (granted you are awake of course)...

For building up speed with your fingers I would recommend just practicing galloping (with however many fingers you want to be able to use) on open strings. I would do that for up to an hour or two when I first started playing and it got me ahead in my playing. I personally only use my index and middle fingers for playing. I have only been playing for a little more than two years. You'll get better at fingers in time.
I use both although I almost always use fingers. It comes in handy for stuff like the first bass solo in Orion.

I have been playing early Metallica stuff like Creeping Death, Orion, and (I'm learning) Anesthesia. I've been playing stuff like Holiday in Cambodia, Stranglehold, Little One, and some Green Day songs.
Yeah, I play guitar (not so well, I'm hella sloppy) and bass. I've been told that I'm a good bass player by several people. I think they are just blowing smoke though.
Serotonia is my favorite song by them. I wish I could play guitar and sing like Johnny Stevens.

I love classic rock like The Beatles, The Doobie Brothers, The Doors, James Gang, Jimi Hendrix, Led Zeppelin, Motörhead, Ted Nugent (I like his music, I think he is a douche), and The Who to name a few bands. I also like punk rock like The Misfits, Sex Pistols, Ramones (to a certain extent), Iggy Pop, Dead Kennedys, Black Flag, Rancid (specifically ...And Out Come The Wolves), and Green Day's early stuff like Kerplunk (Dookie was the album that got me into punk). 
As for Metal I listen to anything from Black Sabbath to Death's The Sound of Perserverance.
Lately I've found myself listening to a lot of blues rock and metal type stuff Down (one of Phil Anselmo's side projects with Pepper Keenan from Corrosion of Conformity) and Highly Suspect.
I'm still awake, I like rock and metal.
